thread:
ana: Quick FYI — Carlos (new hire, Intl 🇲🇽) just tried to complete I-9 via kiosk link but the passport upload failed (file rejected). Passport expiry is in ~2 months. Background check kicked off but flagged for manual review. Need a short day‑1 plan so he can still start Mon.

mike: Is passport expiring <1yr a hard blocker for remote I-9? I thought a passport is fine regardless of expiry as long as currently valid. :thinking_face:

sara: For I-9 we need a valid unexpired ID. If passport expires soon it might still be acceptable if expiry > date? Not 100% — paging policy doc.

ana (onboard-bot): policy-link: /policies/i9-remote -> "Unexpired passport acceptable; if expiring within 6 months, escalate to ppl-ops for alternate verification."

ana: Okay, escalate then. Carlos can't come onsite (he's in Guadalajara). Propose two options: 1) Remote notary appointment we reimburse, do physical sighting + notarized copy; 2) Ask him to upload alternative docs (e.g., unexpired foreign passport + driver license) if he has them. What do you prefer?

devon: IT note — if he needs a same-day laptop we can ship overnight but need sign-off before EOD Fri. If we do notary flow, timeline tight.

mike: Let's try alternative docs first (option 2). Ask Carlos to try uploading PDF again but smaller size and different format (some scanners produce weird MIME). Send sample command he can use: `convert scanned.jpg -resize 2000x2000 -quality 85 out.pdf` or just take a photo with phone and upload.

sara: If upload still fails, we trigger Notary flow. We have a vendor (TrustID) who can do remote identity attestations for Intl hires — costs ~ $50. Approve?

ana: Approve TrustID for this case. Also I'll create a short day-1 override: allow start on Monday pending final I-9 verification + BG manual review, with temporary limited access until completed. Need approvals from security and hiring manager.

mike: Hiring manager (dev lead) already ok with provisional access. Security — @devon can you approve temporary access box? :lock_with_ink_pen:

devon: I can open a scoped, time-limited access token for onboarding (no prod). Will need a ticket in infra-requests. Ana, please create ticket with `onboard-remote-temp-access` and include start/end dates.

ana: Created ticket: infra-requests #8743 — includes Carlos start Mon, end-of-provisional 2 weeks. 

onboard-bot: calendar: Day-1 orientation invite sent to carlos@personal.email, onboarding buddy assigned: sara.

ana: Carlos — quick checklist we sent him (pasted):
- Try upload passport again (jpg/png/pdf, < 10MB).
- If fails, upload alternate ID (national ID + driver’s license) or book TrustID remote notarization (link: https://trustid.example/book).
- Complete background check email from Trustwork within 48h.
- Expect provisional access first day; final access after I-9 cleared.

mike: Also remind him to enroll in benefits during first week: benefits portal link + deadline. I'll DM the benefits link.

ana: I'll follow up with Carlos and cc hiring manager + security. If we get a hard failure, we switch to TrustID notary and cover cost. :+1:

itbot: background-check: status update queued — manual review flagged for Carlos by Trustwork.

ana: Thanks everyone. I'll post a final quick update tomorrow morning. :wave:
